list.name: min_contract_value
list.label: Min contract value (€)
list.description: Minimum contract value filter. A panel only counts a contract when |preço contratual| is greater than or equal to this amount, in euros. The loaded data already leaves out contracts below €10 (the is_below_min_value ingest rule, MIN_VALUE in src/base_gov/stats.py), so 0 and 10 give the same result. €5 000 / €20 000 / €75 000 are the informal reference points used in the notebooks — they are NOT legal CCP thresholds. The absolute value is used, because negative prices occur in the source data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS total_contracts FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a WHERE a.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value}

SELECT coalesce(sum(v.preco_contratual),0) AS total_value FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a WHERE a.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value}

panels.title: Contracts over time

targets.rawSql: WITH u AS (SELECT lo, hi, CASE WHEN hi - lo <= interval '62 days' THEN 'day' WHEN hi - lo <= interval '183 days' THEN 'week' ELSE 'month' END AS unit FROM (SELECT date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AS lo, date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day' AS hi) b), s AS (SELECT gs AS bucket FROM u, generate_series(date_trunc(u.unit, u.lo), u.hi - interval '1 microsecond', ('1 ' || u.unit)::interval) gs), agg AS (SELECT date_trunc(u.unit, v.celebrated_at) AS bucket, count(*) AS val FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v, u WHERE v.celebrated_at >= u.lo AND v.celebrated_at < u.hi AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a WHERE a.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} GROUP BY 1) SELECT s.bucket AS time, coalesce(agg.val, 0) AS contracts FROM s LEFT JOIN agg USING (bucket) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Bucket size follows the time range: day up to 2 months, week (Monday start) up to 6 months, month beyond. The first and last buckets may be partial.

panels.title: Contract value over time

targets.rawSql: WITH u AS (SELECT lo, hi, CASE WHEN hi - lo <= interval '62 days' THEN 'day' WHEN hi - lo <= interval '183 days' THEN 'week' ELSE 'month' END AS unit FROM (SELECT date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AS lo, date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day' AS hi) b), s AS (SELECT gs AS bucket FROM u, generate_series(date_trunc(u.unit, u.lo), u.hi - interval '1 microsecond', ('1 ' || u.unit)::interval) gs), agg AS (SELECT date_trunc(u.unit, v.celebrated_at) AS bucket, sum(v.preco_contratual) AS val FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v, u WHERE v.celebrated_at >= u.lo AND v.celebrated_at < u.hi AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a WHERE a.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND a.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} GROUP BY 1) SELECT s.bucket AS time, coalesce(agg.val, 0) AS contract_value FROM s LEFT JOIN agg USING (bucket) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Bucket size follows the time range: day up to 2 months, week (Monday start) up to 6 months, month beyond. The first and last buckets may be partial.

panels.title: Procedure type — share of count vs share of value

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.procedure_family AS procedure_type, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS "share of count (%)", round(100.0 * sum(v.preco_contratual) / nullif(sum(sum(v.preco_contratual)) OVER (), 0), 1) AS "share of value (%)" FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} GROUP BY v.procedure_family ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Notebook conclusion (procedures_comparison): Ajuste Direto is most contracts by count but a small share of value; Concurso Público is the reverse.

panels.title: Price level by procedure type

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.procedure_family AS procedure_type, count(*) AS contracts, (percentile_cont(ARRAY[0.5, 0.9, 0.99]) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.preco_contratual))[1] AS median, (percentile_cont(ARRAY[0.5, 0.9, 0.99]) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.preco_contratual))[2] AS p90, (percentile_cont(ARRAY[0.5, 0.9, 0.99]) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.preco_contratual))[3] AS p99 FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} GROUP BY v.procedure_family ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Median, 90th and 99th percentile of preço contratual per procedure type.

panels.title: Duration and €/day by procedure type

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.procedure_family AS procedure_type, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.prazo_execucao) AS "median prazo (days)", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.valor_por_dia) AS "median €/day" FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} GROUP BY v.procedure_family ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Median prazo_execucao and valor_por_dia (defined only for 1–3650-day durations).

panels.title: Median €/day by duration bucket

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.duration_bucket AS bucket, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.valor_por_dia) AS "median €/day" FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND v.duration_bucket IS NOT NULL GROUP BY v.duration_bucket ORDER BY min(v.prazo_execucao)

panels.description: Short contracts inflate €/day: the shorter the duration, the higher the daily value.

panels.title: Contract value distribution (informal reference bands)

targets.rawSql: SELECT band, count(*) AS contracts FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN abs(v.preco_contratual) < 1000 THEN '1) < 1k' WHEN abs(v.preco_contratual) < 5000 THEN '2) 1k–5k' WHEN abs(v.preco_contratual) < 20000 THEN '3) 5k–20k' WHEN abs(v.preco_contratual) < 75000 THEN '4) 20k–75k' WHEN abs(v.preco_contratual) < 250000 THEN '5) 75k–250k' ELSE '6) ≥ 250k' END AS band FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value}) t GROUP BY band ORDER BY band

panels.description: Band edges at €5 000 / €20 000 / €75 000 are the informal reference points used in the notebooks (ajuste_direto_contracts) — NOT legal CCP thresholds.

panels.title: Bidders: reported share and single-bidder share

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.n_concorrentes IS NOT NULL) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS "reported (% of contracts)", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.n_concorrentes = 1) / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.n_concorrentes IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS "single bidder (% of reported)" FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value}

panels.description: The single-bidder share denominator is contracts with a reported number of bidders only; concorrentes is null for over half of contracts.

panels.title: Lifecycle: closed share and Σ efetivo − Σ contratual

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.closed_at IS NOT NULL) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS "closed (% of contracts)", coalesce(sum(v.preco_total_efetivo - v.preco_contratual) FILTER (WHERE v.preco_total_efetivo IS NOT NULL), 0) AS "Σ efetivo − Σ contratual (closed)" FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value}

panels.description: Lower bound as of the export date: data_fecho and preco_total_efetivo only populate when a contract is closed.

panels.title: Buyer concentration by procedure type (top-10 share, HHI)

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT v.procedure_family AS procedure_type, v.adjudicante_id, sum(v.preco_contratual) AS val FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario x WHERE x.idcontrato = v.idcontrato AND x.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ',')))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} GROUP BY 1, 2), t AS (SELECT procedure_type, val / nullif(sum(val) OVER (PARTITION BY procedure_type), 0) AS share, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY procedure_type ORDER BY val DESC) AS rn FROM s) SELECT procedure_type, count(*) AS buyers, round(100 * sum(share) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 10), 1) AS "top-10 share (%)", round(sum(share * share)::numeric, 4) AS hhi FROM t GROUP BY procedure_type ORDER BY procedure_type

panels.description: Share of value held by the 10 largest buyers per procedure type, and the Herfindahl–Hirschman index (0 = fragmented, 1 = one buyer).

panels.title: Supplier concentration by procedure type

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT v.procedure_family AS procedure_type, v.adjudicatario_id, sum(v.preco_contratual) AS val FROM procurement.v_adjudicatario_contracts v WHERE (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND ('${adjudicante:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicante_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicante:csv}', ','))) AND ('${adjudicatario:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.adjudicatario_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ','))) AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} GROUP BY 1, 2), t AS (SELECT procedure_type, val / nullif(sum(val) OVER (PARTITION BY procedure_type), 0) AS share, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY procedure_type ORDER BY val DESC) AS rn FROM s) SELECT procedure_type, count(*) AS suppliers, round(100 * sum(share) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 10), 1) AS "top-10 share (%)", round(sum(share * share)::numeric, 4) AS hhi FROM t GROUP BY procedure_type ORDER BY procedure_type

panels.description: A multi-awardee contract counts in full for each awardee, so supplier shares are not additive to the contract total.
